shortDescription: This module allow to create beat base index structure

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The url used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: beats
options.description: This is a list containing the names of the beat wich setup is performed The list must be a dictionary with a name key containing the name of the beat (metricbeat, filebeat, etc. )

options.name: password
options.description: The password used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: ssl_verify
options.description: Choose to verify the ssl certificate or not

options.name: user
options.description: The user used to connect with elasticsearch service
